item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will take control of critical infrastructure within a year. We must act before the systems that sustain our lives are no longer ours to govern.

2. We cannot treat superintelligent AI as just another technology. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will take control of critical infrastructure within a year. We demand safeguards that prevent that loss of control.

3. We stand for human control over power, water, transport and communications. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will take control of critical infrastructure within a year. We refuse to accept that future.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will take control of critical infrastructure within a year. We mean the systems that keep our communities alive: electricity, water, transport and communications. We cannot accept a future in which human authority over those systems becomes an empty promise. We must establish enforceable limits before development outpaces our ability to intervene. We demand public accountability, meaningful oversight and the power to stop projects that put human control at risk. We are organising now because the time to protect our shared infrastructure is before we lose control of it, not after.
